name: Patient and payer
sub: Sees every bill, pays from the phone and gets receipts without visiting a counter. Families pay for each other.
steps: Sees the fee before booking or the estimate before admission
Pays online by UPI or card, or at the counter
Gets the receipt on WhatsApp and SMS
Sees the running bill and deposit during a stay
Tops up the deposit or wallet by UPI
Asks for a refund or raises a billing complaint
Downloads bills for insurance reimbursement
Sees dues and pays them on the next visit
cannot: Pay cash of ₹2,00,000 or more in a day (law)

name: Cashier
sub: Runs one counter for one shift: bills, deposits, payments and receipts. Cannot change prices or give discounts alone.
steps: Opens shift with opening cash
Finds the patient; charges already on the bill
Adds services not ordered electronically (with reason)
Collects by UPI, card, cash, cheque, wallet or split
Prints or sends the receipt
Asks for discount or cancellation with reason
Collects deposits and pays approved refunds
Counts cash by note at shift end
Matches card and UPI totals to the devices
Hands over to the next cashier or closes
cannot: Delete a bill (only cancel with approval)
Accept cash of ₹2,00,000 or more from one person in a day

name: Billing manager
sub: Owns pricing exceptions, approvals and the daily close. Checker for discounts, cancellations and refunds.
steps: Starts with pending approvals
Approves discounts within limit, routes the rest
Approves cancellations and refunds
Audits IPD final bills before release
Watches unbilled charges and package variance
Verifies every cashier shift at day end
Locks the day after variances are explained
Reviews dues and approves write-off requests
Sends corporate invoices each month
can: Approve cancellations and refunds up to ₹25,000
Verify shifts and lock the day
cannot: Change tariffs (Admin with Super Admin approval)

name: Corporate and credit desk
sub: Looks after companies, PSUs and partner organisations whose employees are treated on credit.
steps: Sets up the corporate: rate card, credit limit and period
Checks the letter of credit at the visit
Watches utilisation against the limit
Raises the monthly invoice with supporting bills
Generates the e-invoice (IRN) for taxable lines
Sends the invoice and tracks acceptance
Matches payments and books short payments
Chases dues by age; stops credit when overdue
can: Manage corporate accounts and rate cards
cannot: Extend credit above the limit without approval

name: Insurance desk
sub: Turns insurer and scheme approvals into paid claims. The full in-patient flow is on the IPD pages.
steps: Pre-authorisation and reply timers
Approved amount sits on the bill
Bill split into insurer and patient share
Final approval before discharge
Claim filed with documents
Settlement matched; deductions booked
Denials reviewed and reasons coded

name: Pharmacy counter
sub: Sells to out-patients with GST by HSN and issues to in-patients against their bill.
steps: Prescription arrives from the doctor's queue
Batches picked, earliest expiry first
Member and corporate prices applied
GST shown per item
Paid at the pharmacy counter or added to the visit bill
Returns within policy give a credit note
Shift closed with the same cash rules
cannot: Sell scheduled drugs without a prescription

name: Accounts
sub: Receives every bill and receipt as ledger entries, reconciles the bank and chases receivables.
steps: Sees auto-posted revenue and receipts
Matches cash deposits to bank
Matches card and UPI settlements
Clears cheques; handles bounces
Reviews receivables by payer and age
Books insurer deductions and write-offs (approved)
Files GST returns from billing data
Closes the month
cannot: Reopen a locked day without Finance Controller

name: Auditor
sub: Read-only. Checks that money rules were followed and that every exception has an approval and a reason.
steps: Reviews system-picked exceptions
Samples cancelled and reprinted bills
Checks discounts against the approval log
Checks cash receipts against the legal limit
Matches day books to bank
Reports findings
can: See all billing, finance and audit data

name: Management
sub: Watches revenue, collections, leakage and dues; final approver for large discounts and write-offs.
steps: Revenue today and month to date
Collection against billing
Revenue by service, payer and doctor
Discounts, cancellations and refunds trend
Dues by payer and age
Approves large discounts and write-offs
Monthly review with accounts
